target_source: ∀ (α E : Type*) [MeasurableSpace α] [NormedAddCommGroup E] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) (φ : α → ℝ) (f : α → E) [NormedSpace ℝ E] (p q r : ENNReal) [p.HolderTriple q r], p ≠ 0 → q ≠ 0 → MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable φ μ → MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f μ → MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (fun x => φ x • f x) r μ ≤ MeasureTheory.eLpNorm φ p μ * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f q μ
